meta: AI Development, AI Security and Governance | Argix
AI solutions: assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation, plus AI security testing and AI governance for healthcare, fintech and banking.
h1: AI that removes work, built and secured properly
lead: We add AI to products and workflows where it reduces effort or improves access to information. We also test and govern AI systems the way we test any other software that handles your data.

items.p: Conversational assistants for customers, staff or clinicians, working from your own content.
Search, summarize and extract information from long contracts, clinical notes, reports and forms.
Reduce repetitive administrative work by automating routing, data entry and follow-up.
Smart search, classification, recommendations and forecasting added to applications you already run.
AI scribe, ambient listening that turns conversations into structured notes, and document tools for providers.
Fraud signals, automated document checks during onboarding and customer service assistants.

blocks.lead: AI applications have their own attack surface and their own governance needs.

cols.p: We test AI applications the way an attacker would.
items: Prompt injection and jailbreaking
Leakage of sensitive or private data
Unsafe handling of model output
Excessive permissions given to AI agents and tools
Weak access control on the data an AI can reach

cols.p: Clear rules for how AI is used in your organization.
items: AI usage policies for staff
AI risk assessments
Vendor and model risk reviews
Data protection and privacy checks
Readiness against ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework

blocks.text: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications is one of the references we use when testing AI systems.

blocks.lead: We say so when AI is not the right tool for a problem.
items: Define the problem
Start with the task you want to improve and how you will measure it.
Prove it on a small scope
Test the idea on real data before committing to a full build.
Build and secure
Develop the feature with access controls, logging and a security test.
Measure and improve
Track results against the goal and refine over time.

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Will our data be used to train public models?
We choose providers and configurations that do not train on your data, and we document exactly where data flows before anything is built.
Can you add AI to our existing product?
Yes. We can add features to an existing application, or build a separate service that connects to it through an API.
Can you test an AI application we already run?
Yes. Our penetration testing covers AI applications, including prompt injection, data leakage and agent permissions.

items.p: Web, mobile and API software with security built in.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
EHR, interoperability, AI and digital health software.
